name: IIP Loan Agreement Analyzer
description: Extracts loan agreement quantities, entities, sentiment, and key phrases for the IIP Document Intelligence sample set.

PrincipalAmount.description: The principal loan amount stated in the agreement, typically found near the top of the document

AnnualInterestRatePercent.description: The annual interest rate of the loan expressed as a percentage.

AgreementDate.description: The date on which the loan agreement was executed.

Borrower.description: The borrower party to the loan agreement.

FullName.description: The name of the borrower as stated in the loan agreement.

MailingAddress.description: The mailing address of the borrower.

Lender.description: The lender party to the loan agreement.

FullName.description: The name of the lender as stated in the loan agreement.

MailingAddress.description: The mailing address of the lender.

DueDate.description: The due date for full repayment of the loan as specified in the agreement.

PaymentSchedule.description: The recurring payment terms for the loan.

PaymentFrequency.description: How often recurring payments are due (e.g., monthly, weekly).

PaymentDayOfMonth.description: The day of the month on which recurring payments are due.

FirstPaymentDate.description: The date of the first scheduled recurring payment.

MonthlyPaymentAmount.description: The dollar amount due for each scheduled payment.

NumberOfPayments.description: The total number of scheduled payments over the life of the loan.

LatePaymentFeeAmount.description: The amount charged for late payment as specified in the loan agreement.

GoverningLawState.description: The state whose laws govern the loan agreement.

PaymentAllocationOrder.description: The order in which payments are applied to fees, interest, and principal, quoted directly from the agreement's allocation-of-payments clause.

DefaultInterestRateDescription.description: The clause describing how interest accrues on the unpaid balance if the borrower defaults, quoted directly from the agreement.

BorrowerPrintedName.description: The borrower's printed name from the signature block, if present.

BorrowerSignatureDate.description: The date beside the borrower's signature, if present.

LenderPrintedName.description: The lender's printed name from the signature block, if present.

LenderSignatureDate.description: The date beside the lender's signature, if present.

IsSecuredLoan.description: Answer Unsecured or Secured based on the document

HasAccelerationClause.description: Indicates whether the loan agreement contains an acceleration clause. Answer Yes or No: does the agreement contain an acceleration clause?

HasAttorneyFeesProvision.description: Indicates whether the loan agreement contains an attorney's fees provision. Answer Yes or No: does the agreement contain an attorney's fees provision?

KeyPhrases.description: A list of key words or phrases summarizing the document's main terms.

Sentiment.description: The overall sentiment of the loan agreement document. Possible values are Positive, Negative, or Neutral.
